evals.name: adv-decision
evals.prompt: I'm deciding whether to quit my job to flip furniture full-time. Run it through at least five of the nine models in The Great Mental Models, Vol. 1.
assertions: Applies at least five named models
Uses second-order thinking with concrete consequences
Uses inversion (e.g. what would guarantee failure)
Uses circle of competence and/or probabilistic thinking with numbers
Ends with a decision rule or test, not just a list

evals.name: adv-razors
evals.prompt: Explain the difference between Occam's and Hanlon's razors with a scenario where a Marketplace buyer ghosts me, then show first-principles thinking on pricing.
assertions: Applies both to the ghosting scenario
Uses first principles (breaking down to fundamentals, Socratic questioning or Five Whys) on pricing
